Rides on every trail in the park that's open to bikes: all but the
hiking-only ones. Like the [route of the day](rotd.qmd), they start and finish at the
**Park Centre** (Cleveland Trail at W 16th Ave) and use streets only to link
trails up, at bike distances. Everyone who opens this page on the same day,
with the same choices, gets the same ride of the day; **Another route**
shuffles; [Routes](routes.html?bikes) lists them all. Where a ride crosses a
street on a crosswalk, walk your bike.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// The route picker's settings (_route-picker.qmd): bike routes (step 07,
// MODE=bike), twice the runners' distances, no share link.
PICKER = ({file: "bike_routes.geojson", km: [8, 24], defaultKm: [14, 20], share: false,
           list: "routes.html?bikes"})
```

## Every bike trail in one ride

The bike version of the [Ultra](ultra.qmd): one ride over every trail open
to bikes, from the Park Centre and back, with the same aid stations.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// The every-trail view's settings (_ultra-view.qmd): step 08, MODE=bike.
ULTRA = ({file: "bike_ultra.json", trails: "trail open to bikes", done: "ridden",
          gpxTitle: "Pacific Spirit every bike trail", gpxFile: "psp-bike-every-trail"})
```

{{< include _ultra-view.qmd >}}
